headline: Capri Swings to a Profit as Versace Sale Offsets Revenue Drop
summary: Capri Holdings swung to a fiscal third-quarter profit as the recent sale of its Versace label offset the drop in sales and rising costs.

headline: Capri Cleans Up Balance Sheet With Versace Sale
summary: The parent to Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo nudged past earnings expectations in the fiscal third quarter.
